node.title: Capacidad interna después de la salida
node.summary: The recipient can operate, resolve exceptions and learn after the interveners leave.

relations: Successful engineering needs an institutional handover that preserves ownership, maintenance capacity and recognition after the intervention team leaves.
Una asignación de dueño no demuestra valor realizado y puede fallar si se impone antes de reconstruir la capacidad.
JUBAP's propagation logic can be made operational through evidence that the receiving organization can repeat the practice and handle new exceptions after the team leaves.
No garantía de autosostenibilidad ni obligación de que toda práctica quede completamente documentada.
The Texas-to-Mexico case makes regional capability formation tangible through local roles, acceptance criteria and operating records that let the receiving team execute in its own context.
La preparación audit-ready descrita no equivale a certificación universal ni demuestra por sí sola autonomía futura de cada equipo.
Selective coupling offers a way to discuss the transition between focused intervention and organizational absorption without treating immediate full integration as the default.
El parentesco no demuestra que los casos Tiger Team hayan sido diseñados como pruebas del régimen de Part IV.
The HRIS case illustrates a bounded architecture mandate whose successful exit is a usable transition to scaled delivery, rather than ownership of the entire rollout.
La entrega del blueprint no prueba implementación completa ni realización de las estimaciones económicas del portfolio.
The HR rationalization case makes the distinction concrete: preparing an executable architecture and handover is a different result from completing the full rollout.
La preparación del caso está descrita; el vínculo no atribuye al mismo equipo una implantación posterior no acreditada.
